response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, above_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q

assumptions.assumption: 'Above-average' means the status's average modindex exceeds the overall average modindex across all signals with a non-null modindex (a signal-weighted average, not the mean of the status averages).
Signals with NULL rfistat form one group, which GROUP BY already produces; the status is shown as NULL.
'How far above average' is the status average minus the overall average. The difference from the qualifying mean is the status average minus the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Average' means the unweighted mean of all statuses' average modindex values, so each status counts equally regardless of how many signals it has.
